hazards.control: Bleed the tubing and casing to zero and verify before breaking any connection.
Monitors at the tree; escape sets staged.

name: Stuffing box and pumping tee
function: The packing gland on the pumping tee that seals around the moving polished rod while production leaves through the tee side outlet.

tabs.overview: Packing tightened as it wears; a rod BOP below it isolates the well for packing changes.
tabs.safety: Leak is the first sign of packing wear; bled through the tee before service.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sucker-rod lift, ESP, and gas lift pages (S39, S40, S41); API 11AX, 11E, 11S, 11V (S43 to S46); field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
